question: Oct. 18, 1968, Mexico City: Bob Beamon's long jump flew past the range of the stadium's optical measuring device, so officials grabbed a tape. By how much did he break the world record?
answer_detail: His 8.90 m first-round leap beat the 8.35 m mark shared by Ralph Boston and Igor Ter-Ovanesyan, roughly triple any earlier jump in the record. It stood for nearly 23 years.
